Godzilla and RWBY: Battle for Remnant [Mine; T; Godzilla; RWBY] - 3 chapters so far

Alternate Fanfiction.net link. This version does not contain author commentary. I only do that on AO3 since there is a proper feature for it.

I made this story back in April after being disappointed with the selection of Godzilla fanfics, RWBY fanfics, and crossovers between the two. So I decided to see if I could make a good story out of it.

The Godzilla half of this story is based on Matt Frank's "Godzilla Neo" universe, so some of the Grimm are actually larger than Godzilla himself (being only 60 meters tall). Some changes are made for the sake of the story.

The RWBY half of this story is based on what I've taken away from watching the series, and may not necessarily match up to your own view or to future canon. Again, some changes are made for the sake of the story.

I try to release chapters about every 3 weeks. I use a program called OmniFocus to set due dates and generally keep me on track. The next chapter is due to go live on the 21st of this month, for the curious.

I hope you all enjoy this story.
